articles.summary: NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc. is pleased to announce the appointment of Stephen Connor as National Accounts Manager, West. Bringing more than 20 years of experience in the security and technology industries, Connor will play a key role in expanding NAPCO's national accounts program, strengthening strategic partnerships, and driving business growth throughout the Western United States.
